items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: She was playing piano down there. And then Monty Minelli, you know, when Monty Minelli was playing with that guy? Oh, yeah, sure.

ctx.x: You know, her used to play with my other brother, too. Down where I was talking about the old accent. Who? She played with the name of the artist Louie. That's when, you know, her, Monty Minelli, you know? Yeah, I know.
